title: Predator fence installation
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.ANIMAL AND PLANT HEALTH INSPECTION SERVICE.MRPBS MINNEAPOLIS MN
description_text: USDA’s Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service, Wildlife Services, needs a high-tensile woven wire fence for wolf abatement installed in Marengo, located in Ashland County, Wisconsin. Solicitation documents are posted below. PLEASE NOTE: Interested parties are urged to read at least the first four pages of the RFQ. This will save you and the government time because many of the questions we receive are answered there. Thank you.
